metadata.name: University of Sheffield - Research Data Management Policy

compliance.notes: Details of available support is provided for researchers to be able to comply with the policy

metadata.description: The University of Sheffield maintains this Research Data Management Policy as part of its Good Research and Innovation Practices (GRIP) Policy. This policy aims to provide a strategic framework for the management of data generated by research projects at the University of Sheffield.

sharing_data.notes: 'Documentation and research data should be shared in a research data repository unless there are financial, legal or ethical reasons which mean this is not possible.'

data_protection.notes: Manage personal data in line with the University’s Ethics Policy Governing Research Involving Human Participants, Personal Data and Human Tissue, and data protection legislation.

dmp_development.notes: Not explicit about the timing of DMP development. DMP must be maintained over the life of the project and students must submit it .

sharing_metadata.notes: Data and software documentation should be stored and shared alongside the research data or software.

sharing_research_software.notes: Software must be documented appropriately and stored (with this documentation) in line with the FAIR principles.

data_availability_statement.notes: All researchers are expected to: Include data access statements in published research and formally cite data which informs published research.
